**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") satisfies the TRANSITION rule at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **Assistance period** — 11.1 gives six months of transition assistance on request, at the rates in the expiring Order Form (better for us than "then-current rates"), and expressly covers knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, migration, and continued service at existing scope and service levels.
- **Data return** — 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with relationships and metadata. It also bars Vendor from withholding Customer Data over a fee dispute.
- **Deletion and certification** — 11.3 requires secure deletion from active systems and backups *after* Customer confirms successful return (not immediate deletion), with written certification by an authorized officer; any law-required retained copy stays protected and purpose-restricted.

I also checked Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) per the planner hint: it contains no right for Vendor to withhold data or deliverables for disputed fees — 10.2 in fact requires delivery of paid/proportionately-paid Deliverables and refund of prepaid Fees.
